name: com.truevaluerankings/tvr-mcp
description: Cryptocurrency fundamental analysis tools via MCP. Provides educational scoring and valuation data to help users conduct their own research. Evaluates cryptocurrencies across 8 fundamental metrics rooted in Sound Value principles, producing TVR Scores, TVR Estimated Values, and Valuation Categories. All outputs are model-derived assessments for informational purposes only.

tools.name: get_tvr_score
tools.description: Returns the TVR Score, rank, valuation category, and strongest/weakest metric areas for a cryptocurrency

tools.name: get_tvr_estimated_value
tools.description: Returns the TVR Estimated Value (fair value estimate), fair value gap, and valuation category for a cryptocurrency

tools.name: compare_coins
tools.description: Compares 2-5 cryptocurrencies side-by-side on TVR Score, valuation, and fair value gap

tools.name: get_top_ranked
tools.description: Returns top N cryptocurrencies ranked by TVR Score, most undervalued, or most overvalued

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Explains the 8 metrics, default weights, weight presets, and general scoring approach

tools.name: list_coins
tools.description: Lists all cryptocurrencies currently evaluated by TVR

tools.name: get_full_breakdown
tools.description: PREMIUM: Complete fundamental analysis with all 8 metric scores, explanations, and scoring factors

tools.name: get_historical_scores
tools.description: PREMIUM: Score change history with dates and reasons for each change

tools.name: get_custom_ranking
tools.description: PREMIUM: Recalculate the full ranking table using custom metric weights

tools.name: get_portfolio_analysis
tools.description: PREMIUM: Fundamental strength analysis of a multi-coin portfolio

tools.name: get_comparison_report
tools.description: PREMIUM: Detailed metric-by-metric comparison of 2-5 coins with all 8 scores

free.description: All free tools are accessible with no authentication

premium.description: Premium tools support x402 micropayments in pathUSD on Tempo mainnet
